taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Odufor, Etche LGA survey stations. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 20.32 | 0.13606 | 0.13606
2 | 851.16 | 1.1039 | 1.2399
3 | 2511.9 | 15.803 | 17.043
4 | 1345 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as A-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station Odufor, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station Odufor, Etche LGA**

The interpreted 4-layer vertical electrical sounding (VES) model comprises:
- **Layer 1:** 20.32 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 0.14 m (depth to base: 0.14 m)
- **Layer 2:** 851.16 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 1.10 m (depth to base: 1.24 m)
- **Layer 3:** 2511.9 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 15.80 m (depth to base: 17.04 m)
- **Layer 4:** 1345 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$ (depth > 17.04 m)

Analysis of the layer sequence indicates:
- Layers 1–2–3: $r_1 < r_2 < r_3$ (A-type)
- Layers 2–3–4: $r_2 < r_3 > r_4$ (K-type)

This 4-layer sequence forms an **AK-type** curve. The on-file classification of "A-type" does not match the actual layer values, as resistivity decreases in Layer 4.

{"curve_type_stated": "A", "label_issue_flagged": true}
